scientific_intent.scientific_task: Find minimum total positive edge weight from source vertex 0 to every reachable vertex, retaining unreachable sentinels.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: d[v] = min over source-to-v paths of sum positive edge weights; source represents negative distance and applies atomicMax(cost[v],cost[u]-weight[u,v]).
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: NYR directed CSR graph264346vertices733846edges, maximumdegree8; source hybrid CPU/GPU frontier queues and workgroup local capacity1600.
scientific_intent.independent_validation: CPU binary-heap Dijkstra, complete Bellman inequalities and tight-predecessor witness plus exact source expected NYR distances; independent full output for every selected trial.
scientific_intent.scientific_scope: Unique graph distance solution on four declared graphs/configurations, not arbitrary graph capacity, negative cycles, geographic units, formal concurrent memory-model safety or application-level road routing validation.
